questions.prompt: Do you often remember your dreams when you wake up?
questions.sampleA2: No, I don't remember my dreams. Sometimes I have a dream, but I forget it in the morning. And I don't like to remember them because maybe they are scary.
questions.sampleB1: Not really. I don't often remember my dreams. Sometimes I might remember a little bit, but usually I forget them very quickly after I wake up. I think it's interesting when I do remember them, however, it doesn't happen very often. I wish I could remember them more!
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, not really. Most of the time my dreams just slip away the moment I open my eyes. Every now and then, if a dream is really vivid or a bit strange, a few bits and pieces will stick with me for a while. But I suppose I've never made much of an effort to hold onto them.
questions.uzSampleA2: Yo'q, men tushlarimni eslamayman. Ba'zan tush ko'raman, lekin ertalab unutib qo'yaman. Va ularni eslashni xohlamayman, chunki ular qo'rqinchli bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB1: Unaqa emas. Men ko'pincha tushlarimni eslay olmayman. Ba'zida biroz eslashim mumkin, lekin odatda uyg'onganimdan keyin juda tez unutaman. Agar eslasam, bu juda qiziq deb o'ylayman, lekin bu juda kamdan-kam hollarda sodir bo'ladi. Qaniydi ularni ko'proq eslay olsam!
questions.uzSampleB2: Rostini aytsam, tushlarimni tez-tez eslay olmayman. Ba'zan, agar tush ayniqsa hayratlanarli yoki g'alati bo'lsa, uyg'onganimdan keyin qisqa vaqt davomida uning bir parchasi esimda qolishi mumkin. Biroq, tushlarimning aksariyati deyarli darhol yo'q bo'lib ketadiganga o'xshaydi. O'ylashimcha, bu afsuslanarli, chunki ularning ba'zilari juda qiziqarli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin men ularni doimiy ravishda eslab qolishga hech qachon harakat qilmaganman.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Do you often remember your dreams when you wake up?
idioms: like a dream - "tush ko'rgandek"
beyond one's wildest dreams - "eng yovvoyi orzularidan ham tashqari"
dream come true - "orzu ro'yobga chiqdi"
sentenceStarters: "Yes, I occasionally remember bits and pieces..." - "Ha, men ba'zan eslab qolaman…"
"To be honest, most mornings I..." - "Rostini aytsam, ko'p ertalab men…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Yes, I occasionally remember bits and pieces of my dreams, especially if they were particularly vivid or unusual. Sometimes I wake up with a strong impression of what happened, but it tends to fade quickly within a few minutes.
I find that keeping a dream journal can help me retain the details for a bit longer. Overall, I think dreams are fascinating and I wish I could remember them more often.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ha, men ba'zan tushlarimning parchalarini eslayman, ayniqsa ular juda yorqin yoki g'ayrioddiy bo'lsa. Ba'zan nima bo'lgani haqida kuchli taassurot bilan uyg'onaman, lekin u bir necha daqiqa ichida tezda so'nib ketadi.

Tushlar kundaligini yuritish menga tafsilotlarni biroz uzoqroq saqlab qolishga yordam beradi deb o'ylayman. Umuman olganda, tushlar juda qiziqarli deb o'ylayman va ularni tez-tez eslab qolishni xohlardim.

questions.prompt: How often do you ride a bicycle?
questions.sampleA2: I ride a bicycle. I like it. But I don't ride it a lot because I am busy.
questions.sampleB1: I don't ride a bicycle very often. I used to ride more when I was a kid. Now, I'm usually too busy. However, I think cycling is good exercise, so I should try to do it more.
questions.sampleB2: Honestly, hardly ever these days. I used to cycle all the time as a kid, but now work tends to get in the way. That said, I do hop on my bike now and then for a quick ride around the neighbourhood, especially when the weather's nice. I keep telling myself I should take it up more seriously.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men velosipedda yuraman. Menga yoqadi. Lekin men ko'p minmayman, chunki men bandman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men velosipedda unchalik ko'p minmayman. Bolaligimda ko'proq minardim. Hozir odatda juda bandman.
Shunga qaramay, velosiped haydash yaxshi mashq deb o'ylayman, shuning uchun buni ko'proq qilishga harakat qilishim kerak.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men o'zimni tez-tez velosipedda yuradigan odam deb ayta olmayman. Yoshligimda ancha ko'p velosipedda yurardim, lekin hozir ish va boshqa majburiyatlar bilan bu unchalik ustuvor vazifaga aylanmadi. Men vaqti-vaqti bilan shaharda qisqa sayohatlar uchun velosipeddan foydalanaman, ayniqsa ob-havo yaxshi bo'lsa. Agar men velosiped infratuzilmasi yaxshiroq bo'lgan joyda yashaganimda, ehtimol, muntazam ravishda velosipedda yurishga ko'proq moyil bo'lardim.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - How often do you ride a bicycle?
idioms: get back in the saddle - "qayta urinib ko'rmoq"
it's like riding a bike - "velosiped haydashga o'xshaydi (unutilmaydi)"
reinvent the wheel - "g'ildirakni qayta ixtiro qilmoq"
sentenceStarters: "To be honest, I don't ride a bicycle very..." - "Rostini aytsam, men velosiped minmayman…"
"When I was younger, I used to..." - "Yoshligimda men odatda…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
To be honest, I don't ride a bicycle very often these days, mainly because I live in a busy city where cycling can be quite hazardous. However, when I was younger, I used to ride practically every day after school.
I think cycling is a fantastic form of exercise, and I'd love to pick it up again if I had safer routes nearby.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, hozirgi kunda velosipedda unchalik ko'p haydamayman, asosan gavjum shaharda yashaganim sababli, bu yerda velosiped haydash juda xavfli bo'lishi mumkin. Biroq, yoshligimda maktabdan keyin deyarli har kuni velosiped haydardim.

Menimcha, velosiped haydash ajoyib mashq turi va agar yaqin atrofda xavfsizroq yo'llar bo'lsa, buni yana boshlashni juda xohlardim.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer visiting your relatives or having them visit you?
questions.sampleA1: I like they come. It is good.
questions.sampleA2: I like my family come to my house. Because I can stay home. And I like it.
questions.sampleB1: I think I prefer when my relatives visit me. It's easier because I am at home. I know everything here. However, visiting them is also nice sometimes, especially for holidays. But usually, I like them to come here.
questions.sampleB2: I'd say I lean towards having them come to me, to be honest. It's just more convenient — I'm on my home turf, so I can relax and play the host properly. Visiting them has its perks too, like a change of scenery, but at the end of the day, hosting wins it for me.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga oilam uyimga kelgani yoqadi. Chunki men uyda qolishim mumkin. Va bu menga yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, qarindoshlarimning menga kelishini afzal ko'raman. Chunki men uyda bo'lganim osonroq. Men bu yerda hamma narsani bilaman.
Biroq, ularning oldiga borish ham ba'zan yaxshi, ayniqsa bayramlar uchun. Lekin odatda, ularning bu yerga kelishini xohlayman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Menimcha, qarindoshlarimning o'zlari menga mehmon bo'lishini afzal ko'raman,
asosan, bu menga o'z muhitimda nazorat va tanishlik hissini saqlashga imkon beradi. O'z joyimda bo'lganimda, rejalashtirish va boshqarish osonroq. Albatta, ularning oldiga borishning ham o'z afzalliklari bor, bu kundalik hayotdan tanaffus va ularning hayotini bevosita his qilish imkoniyatini beradi.
Lekin, oxir-oqibat, mehmon qilishning qulayligi men uchun ustunlik qiladi.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Do you prefer visiting your relatives or having them visit you?
idioms: blood is thicker than water - "qon suvdan quyuq (oila muhim)"
make yourself at home - "o'zingizni uyingizdagidek his qiling"
home is where the heart is - "uy — yurak turgan joy"
phrases: comfortable in my own space - "o'z joyimda qulay"
sentenceStarters: "I'd say I generally prefer..." - "Menimcha, men odatda afzal ko'raman…"
"That said, visiting them is also..." - "Shunga qaramay, ularga borish ham…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
I'd say I generally prefer having my relatives visit me because I feel more comfortable in my own space and I can be a good host.
That said, visiting them is also enjoyable because it gives me a change of scenery and a chance to catch up with family members I haven't seen in a while. It really depends on the occasion.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men, odatda, qarindoshlarimning o'zlari menga mehmon bo'lishlarini afzal ko'raman, chunki o'z uyimda o'zimni qulayroq his qilaman va yaxshi mezbon bo'la olaman, deb ayta olaman.

Shunga qaramay, ularning oldiga borish ham yoqimli, chunki bu menga manzara o'zgarishini va ancha vaqtdan beri ko'rmagan oila a'zolarim bilan uchrashish imkoniyatini beradi. Bu, aslida, vaziyatga bog'liq.

questions.prompt: What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA1:
I see family. They are happy.

I see boy. He plays game.
questions.sampleA2:
I see a family. They are playing a game and they are happy.

And I see a boy. He is playing video games. He is alone.
questions.sampleB1:
In the first picture, I can see a family playing a board game together. They look like they are having fun.

In the second picture, there's a boy playing a video game. He's by himself.

I think the first picture is better because it's good to spend time with family.
questions.sampleB2: The first picture shows a family of four gathered around a wooden table, clearly enjoying each other's company. They're playing dominoes, and everyone seems engaged and happy. In contrast, the second image depicts a young man intensely focused on a video game. He's wearing headphones and holding a controller, sitting in a gaming chair with a large monitor in front of him. He looks excited, perhaps in the heat of the moment during gameplay. Overall, these two pictures present different forms of recreation: one highlights social interaction and bonding, while the other emphasizes individual entertainment and immersion.
questions.uzSampleA1:
Men oilani ko'ryapman. Ular baxtli.

Men bolani ko'ryapman. U o'yin o'ynayapti.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men bir oilani ko'ryapman. Ular o'yin o'ynashyapti va ular xursand.

Va men bir bolani ko'ryapman. U video o'yinlar o'ynayapti. U yolg'iz.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Birinchi rasmda men bir oilani birgalikda stol o'yini o'ynayotganini ko'ryapman. Ularning kayfiyatlari yaxshidek ko'rinadi.

Ikkinchi rasmda esa, bir bola video o'yin o'ynayapti. U yolg'iz.

Menimcha, birinchi rasm yaxshiroq, chunki oila bilan vaqt o'tkazish yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Birinchi rasmda stol atrofida yig'ilgan, ko'rinishidan stol o'yini o'ynab zavqlanayotgan oilani ko'rish mumkin. Ular juda baxtli va bir-biriga bog'langan ko'rinadi.

Ikkinchi rasmda video o'yinga berilib ketgan, o'z olamida butunlay yolg'iz o'smir tasvirlangan.

Bu ikki rasm o'rtasidagi farq juda qiziqarli. Birinchisi ijtimoiy aloqa va oilaviy rishtalarning muhimligini ta'kidlasa, ikkinchisi ko'proq individualistik va ehtimol ajratuvchi ko'ngilochar shaklini ifodalaydi.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - What do you see in these pictures?
idioms: a world of difference - "katta farq"
the more the merrier - "qancha ko'p bo'lsa, shuncha qiziq"
a picture is worth a thousand words - "bir rasm ming so'zga arziydi"
sentenceStarters: "In the first picture, I can see..." - "Birinchi rasmda men ko'ryapman…"
"The contrast between the two..." - "Ikkalasi orasidagi farq…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
In the first picture, I can see a happy family of four sitting around a dining table, laughing together while playing a colourful board game with dice and cards. They seem to be thoroughly enjoying each other's company.
In the second picture, there's a teenager wearing headphones, sitting in a gaming chair and intensely playing a video game on a large screen with a controller. The contrast between the two images is quite striking — one shows social bonding while the other depicts a more solitary experience.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Birinchi rasmda men to'rtta a'zodan iborat baxtli oilani ovqatlanish stolida o'tirganini, birgalikda kulishib, zar va kartalari bor rang-barang stol o'yinini o'ynayotganini ko'ryapman. Ular bir-birlari bilan muloqotdan juda ham zavqlanayotganga o'xshaydi.

Ikkinchi rasmda esa, naushnik taqqan, o'yin kreslosida o'tirgan va katta ekranda kontroller bilan video o'yinni qizg'in o'ynayotgan o'smir bor. Ikkala rasm o'rtasidagi farq juda sezilarli — biri ijtimoiy aloqalarni ko'rsatsa, ikkinchisi yolg'izlikdagi tajribani aks ettiradi.

questions.prompt: What are the advantages of playing games with family or friends?
questions.sampleA1: I like games. Play games with family is fun. I am happy.
questions.sampleA2: I like to play games with my family. It is fun and we laugh a lot. We play cards and board games. Sometimes I win, but sometimes I lose. It's okay because it is fun.
questions.sampleB1: I think playing games with family and friends is a good idea. It's fun, of course, but also it helps you to spend time together. For example, we play board games on Sunday evenings. It's a nice way to relax. However, sometimes someone gets angry if they lose!
questions.sampleB2: There are loads of upsides, I think. First off, it's brilliant quality time — you're all together, away from your screens, actually talking and laughing. It also brings people closer, since you learn to cooperate and be a good sport. On top of that, plenty of board games get your brain working, so it's fun and educational at the same time.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men o'yinlarni yaxshi ko'raman. Oila bilan o'yin o'ynash qiziqarli. Men xursandman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men oilam bilan o'yin o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Bu qiziqarli va biz ko'p kulamiz. Biz karta va stol o'yinlarini o'ynaymiz. Ba'zida men yutaman, lekin ba'zida yutqazaman. Hechqisi yo'q, chunki bu qiziqarli.
questions.uzSampleB1:
O'ylaymanki, oila va do'stlar bilan o'yin o'ynash yaxshi fikr. Bu, albatta, qiziqarli, lekin shuningdek, birga vaqt o'tkazishga yordam beradi.
Masalan, biz yakshanba oqshomlarida stol o'yinlarini o'ynaymiz. Bu dam olishning yaxshi usuli.
Biroq, ba'zida kimdir yutqazsa, jahli chiqadi!
questions.uzSampleB2: Oila yoki do'stlar bilan o'yin o'ynashning bir nechta afzalliklari bor. Birinchidan, bu ekranlar va boshqa chalg'ituvchi narsalardan uzoqda, birgalikda sifatli vaqt o'tkazishning ajoyib usuli. Shuningdek, u munosabatlarni mustahkamlashga yordam beradi, chunki siz hamkorlik qilishni va samarali muloqot qilishni o'rganasiz. Bundan tashqari, o'yinlar ta'limiy bo'lishi mumkin; masalan, ko'plab stol o'yinlari strategik fikrlash va muammolarni hal qilish ko'nikmalarini talab qiladi. Nihoyat, va ehtimol eng muhimi, bu shunchaki juda qiziqarli va stressni bartaraf etishning yaxshi usuli.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - What are the advantages of playing games with family or friends?
idioms: the family that plays together stays together - "birga o'ynaydigan oila birga qoladi"
quality time - "sifatli vaqt (yaqinlar bilan)"
all work and no play makes Jack a dull boy - "faqat ish va dam olmaslik odamni zerikarli qiladi"
sentenceStarters: "There are numerous advantages to..." - "…ning ko'plab afzalliklari bor…"
"First and foremost, it strengthens..." - "Eng avvalo, bu mustahkamlaydi…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are numerous advantages to playing games with family or friends. First and foremost, it strengthens bonds between people, as sharing laughs and friendly competition creates lasting memories.
Board games, in particular, encourage face-to-face interaction, which is becoming increasingly rare in our digital age. Additionally, group games can help develop important social skills such as teamwork, patience, and good sportsmanship.
For children, playing with family members provides a sense of security and belonging. Overall, it's a wholesome activity that benefits people of all ages.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Oila yoki do'stlar bilan o'yin o'ynashning ko'plab afzalliklari bor. Birinchi navbatda, bu odamlar o'rtasidagi aloqalarni mustahkamlaydi, chunki kulgularni baham ko'rish va do'stona raqobat uzoq muddatli xotiralarni yaratadi.

Ayniqsa, stol o'yinlari yuzma-yuz muloqotni rag'batlantiradi, bu bizning raqamli davrimizda tobora kamayib bormoqda. Bundan tashqari, guruh o'yinlari jamoaviy ish, sabr-toqat va yaxshi sportchilik kabi muhim ijtimoiy ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirishga yordam beradi.

Bolalar uchun oila a'zolari bilan o'ynash xavfsizlik va mansublik hissini beradi. Umuman olganda, bu barcha yoshdagi odamlarga foyda keltiradigan foydali mashg'ulotdir.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer playing video games by themselves?
questions.sampleA1: I like games. Alone game is good. No friends. I win.
questions.sampleA2: I like to play video games. Sometimes I play alone. I like it because I can play what I want. And I don't need to wait for other people. It's more easy.
questions.sampleB1: Some people like playing video games by themselves, I think. It's maybe because they don't want to play with others. Also, they can choose the game they want. For example, if you play with friends, you have to agree on one game. But alone, you can just play what you like. It can be more relaxing.
questions.sampleB2: Well, there are a few reasons, I suppose. For one thing, playing solo gives you total freedom — you set the pace and pick whatever game you fancy, with no one to answer to. For others, it's a way to unwind after a hectic day. And honestly, a lot of single-player games have such gripping stories that you can completely lose yourself in them.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men o'yinlarni yaxshi ko'raman. Yolg'iz o'ynash yaxshi. Do'stlar yo'q. Men yutaman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men video o'yinlar o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Ba'zida men yolg'iz o'ynayman. Menga bu yoqadi, chunki men xohlagan narsamni o'ynay olaman. Va boshqa odamlarni kutishimga hojat yo'q. Bu osonroq.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Ba'zi odamlar video o'yinlarni yolg'iz o'ynashni yoqtirishadi, menimcha. Ehtimol, ular boshqalar bilan o'ynashni xohlamaydilar. Shuningdek, ular o'zlari xohlagan o'yinni tanlashlari mumkin.
Masalan, agar siz do'stlaringiz bilan o'ynasangiz, bitta o'yin haqida kelishib olishingiz kerak. Ammo yolg'iz o'zingiz, shunchaki o'zingizga yoqqan narsani o'ynashingiz mumkin. Bu ko'proq dam beruvchi bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Xo'sh, menimcha, kimdir yolg'iz o'yin o'ynashni afzal ko'rishining bir nechta sabablari bor.
Birinchidan, bu to'liq avtonomiyani ta'minlaydi; siz hech qanday tashqi bosimsiz sur'at va o'yin tanlashni nazorat qilasiz.
Ikkinchidan, ba'zi odamlar boshqalar bilan onlayn yoki hatto shaxsan muloqot qilishni juda charchatadi deb bilishadi, shuning uchun yolg'iz o'ynash juda zarur bo'lgan dam olish imkoniyatini beradi.
Nihoyat, ba'zi bir o'yinchi o'yinlari haqiqatan ham qiziqarli hikoyalarni taklif qiladi va bu hikoyalarni yolg'izlikda boshdan kechirish juda hayajonli va foydali bo'lishi mumkin. Siz o'yinga chinakam sho'ng'ib ketishingiz mumkin.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Why do some people prefer playing video games by themselves?
idioms: to each their own - "har kimning o'z didi bor"
in one's own bubble - "o'z dunyosida"
recharge one's batteries - "kuch to'plamoq"
phrases: unwind and de-stress - "dam olish va stressni tushirish"
sentenceStarters: "There are several reasons why..." - "Buning bir necha sababi bor…"
"For many, solo gaming is a way to..." - "Ko'pchilik uchun yolg'iz o'ynash…"

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are several reasons why some people prefer playing video games alone. Primarily, it offers a sense of personal freedom — they can play at their own pace without having to coordinate with others or compromise on which game to play.
For many, solo gaming is a way to unwind and de-stress after a long day, providing a kind of mental escape from reality. Some people are also more introverted by nature and find social gaming somewhat draining rather than relaxing.
Furthermore, single-player games often have immersive storylines that are best experienced alone, allowing the player to fully engage with the narrative.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ba'zi odamlarning video o'yinlarni yolg'iz o'ynashni afzal ko'rishlarining bir nechta sabablari bor. Asosan, bu shaxsiy erkinlik hissini beradi — ular boshqalar bilan muvofiqlashmasdan yoki qaysi o'yinni o'ynash bo'yicha murosaga kelmasdan, o'z tezligida o'ynashlari mumkin.
Ko'pchilik uchun yolg'iz o'yin o'ynash uzoq kundan keyin dam olish va stressdan xalos bo'lish usuli bo'lib, haqiqatdan ruhiy qochish imkoniyatini beradi. Ba'zi odamlar tabiatan ko'proq introvert bo'lishadi va ijtimoiy o'yinlarni dam olishdan ko'ra biroz charchatuvchi deb bilishadi.
Bundan tashqari, yakka o'yinlarda ko'pincha yolg'iz o'ynaganda eng yaxshi tajriba olinadigan qiziqarli syujetlar mavjud bo'lib, bu o'yinchiga hikoyaga to'liq sho'ng'ish imkonini beradi.

questions.prompt: Describe a time you lost something important.
questions.sampleA1: I lost my key. I am sad. Key is important.
questions.sampleA2: I lost my phone last year. It was new and I liked it very much. I looked everywhere but I couldn't find it. I was very upset because I had many photos on it.
questions.sampleB1: I remember once I lost my passport when I was travelling. It was really stressful because I needed it to get back home. I searched everywhere in my bag and in the hotel room. Eventually, I found it in the pocket of my jacket. I was so relieved, and now I always keep my passport in a safe place.
questions.sampleB2: I'd like to talk about the time I lost my late grandfather's watch, which honestly still stings when I think about it. It was an old, slightly worn mechanical watch that he'd worn every single day, and he passed it down to me before he died. It wasn't worth a fortune, but to me it was priceless because of everything it stood for. I lost it during a trip abroad. I'd taken it off to go through airport security and, in the rush, I must have left it in one of those plastic trays. By the time I realised, we were already boarding, and although I rang the airport again and again, it never turned up. I was absolutely gutted, and I spent the rest of that holiday kicking myself for being so careless. That whole experience completely changed how I look after my belongings. Before, I was pretty careless — I'd leave things lying around without a second thought. Now I'm far more mindful, and I make a real effort to keep track of anything that matters to me, especially the sentimental stuff. As for why people get so attached to physical objects, I think it comes down to memories. An object isn't just an object; it's a link to a person, a place or a moment we hold dear. Whenever I picture that watch, I picture my grandfather, so in a way, holding onto it felt like holding onto him. That emotional connection is what makes certain things truly irreplaceable, no matter how much they actually cost.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men kalitimni yo'qotdim. Men xafaman. Kalit muhim.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men o'tgan yili telefonimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. U yangi edi va menga juda yoqardi. Men hamma joydan qidirdim, lekin uni topa olmadim. Men juda xafa bo'ldim, chunki unda ko'p rasmlarim bor edi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Esimda, bir safar sayohat qilayotganimda pasportimni yo'qotib qo'yganman. Bu juda stressli edi, chunki uyga qaytish uchun u kerak edi. Sumkamning ichida va mehmonxona xonasida hamma joyni qidirdim.
Oxir-oqibat, uni kurtkamning cho'ntagidan topdim. Juda xursand bo'ldim va endi har doim pasportimni xavfsiz joyda saqlayman.
questions.uzSampleB2: Bir necha yil oldin, universitet diplom ishim topshirish muddatidan oldin, ichida diplom ishim bo'lgan USB fleshkani yo'qotib qo'ydim. Men juda vahimaga tushdim. bulletPoints: Describe a time you lost something important.
How did this loss change how you value your belongings?
Why do people attach emotional value to physical objects?
questions.sampleAnswer:
A time I lost something important:
I'd like to talk about a time when I lost my grandmother's vintage wristwatch, which she had given me as a birthday gift. I was devastated because it wasn't just a watch — it held enormous sentimental value. I remember searching everywhere, retracing my steps for days, but unfortunately, I never found it.
How this loss changed me:
This loss profoundly changed how I value my belongings. Before that incident, I used to be quite careless with my possessions, leaving things lying around without a second thought. Afterwards, I became much more mindful and organised, always making sure to keep track of items that matter to me.
Why people attach emotional value to objects:
As for why people attach emotional value to physical objects, I believe it's because these items often represent cherished memories and connections with loved ones. A simple object can serve as a reminder of a special person or a meaningful moment in our lives.

questions.prompt: Parents should limit the time their children spend playing video games.
questions.sampleA1: Yes, I think. Video games, no good. Play outside. Good for you.
questions.sampleA2: I think video games are okay, but not too much. My brother plays a lot and he doesn't do homework. It's better to play outside and read books, because it's good for you.
questions.sampleB1: I think parents should limit video game time. It's important for kids to do other things, like sports and homework. If they play too much, they won't do well in school. However, some games can be fun and help with problem-solving, so it's about finding a balance.
questions.sampleB2: This is a really hot topic among parents these days, and I can see where both sides are coming from. On the one hand, those in favour of setting limits have a strong case. Too much gaming can quickly turn into an unhealthy habit, and it eats into time that kids could spend studying, playing sport or seeing their friends face to face. Hours glued to a screen also tend to encourage a sedentary lifestyle, and gaming late into the night can really mess with a child's sleep. So from that angle, a few sensible boundaries make perfect sense. On the other hand, plenty of people argue that gaming isn't all bad. Lots of games actually sharpen strategic thinking, problem-solving and creativity, which are genuinely useful skills both in and out of the classroom. In moderation, it's also a great way for kids to switch off and let off steam after a long day at school. On top of that, banning games outright can backfire, leaving children feeling left out when their friends are all chatting about the latest release. Personally, I'm firmly in the camp of moderation rather than an outright ban. I don't think slamming the door on games is the answer; instead, parents should sit down with their kids and agree on reasonable limits together. That way, children still get to enjoy their hobby, but they also learn a bit of self-discipline along the way — and honestly, that balance is a skill that'll serve them well for the rest of their lives.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha, men o'ylayman. Video o'yinlar, yaxshi emas. Tashqarida o'ynash kerak. Siz uchun foydali.

questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, ota-onalar video o'yinlar vaqtini cheklashi kerak. Bolalar sport va uy vazifalari kabi boshqa narsalar bilan shug'ullanishlari muhim. Agar ular juda ko'p o'ynasalar, maktabda yaxshi o'qiy olmaydilar.
Shunga qaramay, ba'zi o'yinlar qiziqarli bo'lishi va muammolarni hal qilishga yordam berishi mumkin, shuning uchun bu muvozanatni topish haqida.
questions.uzSampleB2: Menimcha, ota-onalar bolalarning video o'yinlarga sarflaydigan vaqtini nazorat qilishlari maqsadga muvofiq. O'yin o'ynash qo'l-ko'z koordinatsiyasini va strategik fikrlashni yaxshilash kabi foydali jihatlarga ega bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, haddan tashqari ekran vaqti o'qish, muloqot qilish va jismoniy mashqlar kabi muhim faoliyatlardan chalg'itishi mumkin. Shuningdek, uyqu tartibiga va umumiy farovonlikka potentsial ta'sirini ham ko'rib chiqishga arziydi. Biroq, video o'yinlarni butunlay taqiqlash teskari natija berishi mumkin; yanada samaraliroq yondashuv - bu me'yorni va turli xil qiziqishlarni rag'batlantirish bo'ladi.

questions.sampleAnswer:
This is a highly debated topic in modern parenting. On the one hand, those who support limiting screen time argue that it prevents addiction and helps children maintain focus on their studies. Excessive gaming can also lead to a sedentary lifestyle, so setting boundaries encourages more physical activity and real social interaction. Moreover, reducing game time before bed promotes better sleep and a more balanced daily routine.
However, opponents point out that many video games actually develop strategic thinking and creativity, which are valuable cognitive skills. They also argue that moderate gaming can be a perfectly healthy way to relieve stress and unwind. Furthermore, total restriction may backfire, as children could feel isolated from their peers who discuss and play these games together.
Personally, I believe the key lies in finding a balance. Parents should guide their children rather than impose strict bans, helping them develop self-discipline that will serve them well throughout life.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu zamonaviy ota-onalikda juda ko'p bahs-munozaralarga sabab bo'ladigan mavzu. Bir tomondan, ekran vaqtini cheklashni qo'llab-quvvatlovchilar, bu giyohvandlikning oldini olishini va bolalarga o'qishga e'tiborini saqlashga yordam berishini ta'kidlaydilar. Haddan tashqari o'yin o'ynash ham harakatsiz turmush tarziga olib kelishi mumkin, shuning uchun chegaralarni belgilash ko'proq jismoniy faollikni va haqiqiy ijtimoiy muloqotni rag'batlantiradi. Bundan tashqari, uxlashdan oldin o'yin vaqtini qisqartirish yaxshiroq uyquni va yanada muvozanatli kun tartibini ta'minlaydi.

Biroq, qarshi tomonlar ko'plab video o'yinlar aslida strategik fikrlashni va ijodkorlikni rivojlantirishini ta'kidlaydilar, bu qimmatli kognitiv ko'nikmalardir. Ular, shuningdek, o'rtacha o'yin o'ynash stressni bartaraf etish va dam olishning mukammal sog'lom usuli bo'lishi mumkinligini ta'kidlaydilar. Bundan tashqari, to'liq cheklov teskari ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin, chunki bolalar bu o'yinlarni birgalikda muhokama qiladigan va o'ynaydigan tengdoshlaridan ajralib qolishlari mumkin.

Shaxsan men, muvozanatni topish muhim deb hisoblayman. Ota-onalar qat'iy taqiqlarni o'rnatishdan ko'ra, bolalariga yo'l-yo'riq ko'rsatishlari, ularga hayot davomida asqatadigan o'z-o'zini tarbiyalashni rivojlantirishga yordam berishlari kerak.
